description: Datos de entrada de agua a la Planta potabilizadora is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. Information on hardness, conductivity, litres captured per inhabitant volume and source of water. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. The portal shows the English title as "Water input data to the purification plant" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Zaragoza. The listing shows 1 download or service links in API. The listing shows 2017-05-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.zaragoza.es/sede/portal/aviso-legal#condiciones). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
